create_batch_microbatch: create a Batch object to wrap a single tensor or list of tensors as a microbatch for pipeline parallelism
wrap_tensor_nochunk: wrap a tensor with NoChunk to replicate it across all micro-batches without chunking on the batch dimension
scatter_input_microbatches: scatter input tensors into multiple micro-batches by chunking along the batch dimension
gather_microbatch_outputs: gather output micro-batches and concatenate them back into a single mini-batch tensor
check_inputs_device: check that all input tensors are on the same device as the first partition
